metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Returns vs. Buffalo
metadata.description: Gilliam (ankle) has returned to Sunday's game against the Bills, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam had to be carted off the field after sustaining an ankle injury. However, the veteran fullback passed the medical staff's tests and was back on the field for the second half.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Carted off field, questionable to return
metadata.description: Gilliam (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Bills.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam injured his ankle during the first quarter, and the injury was severe enough for him to be taken to the locker room, where he'll undergo further tests to determine whether he can return. The Patriots don't have another fullback on the roster, so they could turn to tight ends Cameron Latu and Eli Raridon to serve as blockers out of the backfield while Gilliam is out of the game.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Good to go against Buffalo
metadata.description: Gilliam (knee) is active against the Bills on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: The veteran fullback has been working through a knee injury, but he's been cleared by medical staff to play after going through pregame warmups. Gilliam spent the first six years of his NFL career with the Bills before signing a three-year contract with the Patriots in March.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Questionable for Week 4
metadata.description: Gilliam (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Buffalo, Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam has been working through a knee injury the past couple of weeks, but he's drawn the questionable tag for Week 4 after fading such a designation for Week 3 against the Jaguars. He's contributed on special teams and has worked mostly as a blocker on offense, so if Gilliam is not cleared to play against the Bills, then the Patriots may turn to tight ends like Cameron Latu or Eli Raridon (thigh) to block out of the backfield.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam (knee) back at practice Friday
metadata.description: Reggie Gilliam returned to practice on Friday.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam will still need to be monitored on the injury report when it is released this afternoon.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Doesn't practice Thursday
metadata.analysis: Gilliam was limited during Wednesday's practice, though he saw a worrisome downgrade Thursday. As a result, he may carry an injury designation ahead of Sunday's AFC East showdown with Buffalo, assuming he's not ruled out altogether before then. The 29-year-old appeared in the Patriots' first three games of the 2026 campaign, catching one pass (two targets) for four yards.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam (knee) misses practice Thursday
metadata.description: Reggie Gilliam did not practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam was limited in practice on Wednesday. His status week need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Still working through knee issue
metadata.description: Gilliam (knee) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam was able to play in the Patriots' Week 3 loss to the Jaguars after working through a knee issue during practice prep. He played a total of 19 snaps (eight on offense, 11 on special teams) without showing up on the box score otherwise. Gilliam will have two more opportunities to log a full practice and avoid an injury designation for Sunday's AFC East tilt against the Bills.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Ready for Sunday
metadata.description: Gilliam (knee) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam was limited in all three Week 3 practice sessions. The fullback sustained a knee injury during the Patriots' Week 2 win over the Steelers, but it won't stop the 29-year-old from suiting up for Sunday's game against the Jaguars. Gilliam has seen 33 offensive snaps and 26 special-teams snaps through two games in 2026.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Dealing with knee injury
metadata.description: Gilliam (knee) was a limited participant at the Patriots' practice Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam appears to have left Sunday's 20-3 win over the Steelers a little worse for wear, picking up a knee injury at some point during the contest. The fullback will have two more chances to log a full practice before the team's Week 3 matchup with Jacksonville.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam signs three-year deal with Patriots
metadata.description: The Patriots signed FB Reggie Gilliam to a three-year contract.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam will earn $6 million fully guaranteed and up to $12 million. He'll help the blocking for Drake Maye and the Patriots offense.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Agrees to join NE for three years
metadata.description: Gilliam agreed to a three-year contract worth up to $12 million with the Patriots on Monday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam's deal, which can be made official Wednesday at the start of the new league year, includes $6 million in guaranteed money and a salary of $4.4 million in the first year. The fullback spent the previous six seasons with the NFC East rival Bills, compiling 16 catches for 135 yards and two touchdowns, as well as eight carries for 14 yards, in 94 regular-season appearances.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam (illness) DNP Wednesday
metadata.description: Bills FB Reggie Gilliam did not participate in Wednesday's practice ahead of Week 18.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam has yet to miss a game in 2025. Buffalo is considering resting its starters in Week 18, and Gilliam may be on that list.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - No touches in Week 16
metadata.description: Gilliam went without a carry or target while playing 11 of the Bills' 50 offensive snaps in Sunday's 23-20 win over the Browns.
metadata.analysis: The 28-year-old fullback has been active for all 15 of the Bills' games this season but has been deployed almost exclusively as a blocker on offense, recording no carries and just one reception for two yards. Gilliam remains a core special teams player for the Bills and has notched 12 tackles on the team's coverage units this season.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Logs 21 snaps in Week 6
metadata.description: Gilliam went without a carry or target while playing 21 of the Bills' 57 offensive snaps in Monday's 24-14 loss to the Falcons.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam was credited with his second start of the season since he was on the field for the Bills' first play, but he was still limited to just 37 percent of the offensive snaps even though Buffalo leaned into more heavy packages with tight end Dalton Kincaid (oblique) inactive for the contest. The Bills will continue to deploy Gilliam almost exclusively as a blocker anytime he's on the field; the fullback has yet to draw a target or carry the ball through six games and was limited to just three touches for the entire 2024 season.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Suits up vs. Giants
metadata.description: Gilliam (groin) secured his only target for 19 yards during Saturday's 35-24 preseason loss to the Giants.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam had been managing a groin injury, but he was healthy enough to suit up for preseason action Saturday and connect with quarterback Mitchell Trubisky for a 19-yard gain in the second quarter. The fullback appeared in 15 regular-season games with Buffalo in 2024, though he only logged three carries for seven yards in that span.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Working through groin injury
metadata.description: Gilliam did not participate in Sunday's training camp practice due to a groin injury, Sal Capaccio of WGR Sports Radio 550 Buffalo reports.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam may have picked up the injury during Friday's practice session, and he'll be held out as a precaution to avoid aggravation. The Bills don't have any other fullback on the roster, but if Gilliam were to miss Saturday's preseason opener against the Giants, Buffalo could opt to use tight ends Jackson Hawes, Zach Davidson or Matt Sokol as backfield blockers in run schemes.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam re-signs with Bills
metadata.description: The Bills re-signed FB Reggie Gilliam to a one-year, $2 million contract.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam will continue to primarily hold a role on special teams for Buffalo.

metadata.title: Reggie Gilliam - Back with Buffalo
metadata.description: The Bills re-signed Gilliam to a one-year, $2 million contract Tuesday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: Gilliam appeared in 15 regular-season games last season and has spent his entire five-year career with the Bills. He played just 139 offensive snaps in 2024 and wasn't targeted in the passing game but did rush three times for seven scoreless yards. Gilliam doesn't do anything noteworthy in the box score but is a good glue guy for the Bills.
